_comment: English training set, 15 intents x 20 examples, campus-assistant domain. Train on this ONLY; never on test_multilingual.json. Responses are a static KB; one is picked at random per prediction.

examples: which classes do I have tomorrow
where can I see my timetable
what time does the first lecture start
do I have a class at 3 pm
what is the schedule for Monday
how many lectures do I have today
when is the AI lab session
is there a free period now
which room is my next class in
responses: You can view your class timetable on the NCU ERP portal under Academics → Timetable. It reflects your registered sections.
Your daily schedule is on the ERP (Academics → My Timetable). Today's classes and room numbers are listed there.
Check the ERP portal for the live timetable — it stays updated if a lecture is rescheduled.
Timetables are published per section on the ERP. Log in and open Academics → Timetable to see today's classes.

examples: when do mid semester exams start
when is the end semester examination
has the exam date sheet been released
what is the date of the first exam
when do we have our finals
responses: Exam date sheets are published on the NCU ERP under Examination → Date Sheet, usually 2–3 weeks before exams begin.
Check the Examination section of the ERP portal for the official date sheet of mid-semester and end-semester exams.
The examination cell releases the date sheet on the ERP and the notice board near the admin block.
Exam schedules are announced on the ERP under Examinations. Watch for the official notification too.

examples: when will the results be declared
how do I check my results
where can I see my grades
can I see my grade card
when will we get our marks
how do I apply for revaluation
responses: Results are declared on the NCU ERP under Examination → Results. You're notified by email when they're out.
Log in to the ERP and open Examination → Grade Card to view your SGPA/CGPA and subject-wise marks.
Results are typically declared 3–4 weeks after end-semester exams on the ERP portal.
You can check marks and download your grade card from the ERP. Revaluation forms are also available there after result declaration.

examples: how much is the semester fee
what is the last date to pay fees
is there a late fee fine
can I pay fees in installments
where do I pay the hostel fee
how to get a fee receipt
what happens if I miss the fee deadline
how to apply for a fee concession
how much is the bus fee
responses: The fee structure is available on the NCU website under Admissions → Fee Structure, and payment happens through the ERP or the fee portal.
Pay fees online via the ERP fee portal (UPI, cards, net banking). Deadlines and late-fee rules are notified each semester.
For fee amounts, deadlines and scholarships, check the ERP fee section or contact the accounts office in the admin block.
Fee receipts auto-generate on the ERP after payment. For installments or concessions, visit the accounts office.

examples: how do I apply for hostel
is hostel mandatory for first year
how to book a hostel room
single room or sharing in hostel
what facilities are there in the hostel
can I change my hostel room
what time does the hostel gate close
responses: Hostel applications open on the ERP before each semester. Rooms are allotted by the hostel office based on availability.
For hostel fees, room types (single/sharing) and rules, see the Hostel section on the NCU website or visit the hostel office.
Hostel facilities include mess, Wi-Fi and laundry. Warden contact details are posted on each hostel's notice board.
Room changes and guest requests go through your hostel warden. Gate timings are in the hostel rulebook you get at allotment.

examples: how many books can I issue
how to renew a library book
is the library open on sunday
how to search for a book in the library
fine for late return of books
does the library have a reading room
library card lost what to do
how long can I keep a borrowed book
can I suggest a book for the library
responses: The central library is open on working days (typically 9 am–8 pm) with reduced weekend hours — current timings are posted at the entrance and on the ERP.
Students can issue a fixed number of books (usually 4) for two weeks; renewals are possible at the circulation desk or online.
Late returns carry a small daily fine. You can access e-journals through the library section of the NCU website.
For book search use the OPAC terminal in the library; for a lost library card, report at the circulation desk to get a duplicate.

examples: how do I check my attendance
what is the minimum attendance required
my attendance is short what will happen
how much attendance do I have in maths
can I sit in the exam with 70 percent attendance
teacher marked me absent by mistake
how to apply for attendance condonation
does medical leave count in attendance
how often is attendance updated on erp
will I be detained for low attendance
how to correct wrong attendance entry
responses: Attendance is tracked per subject on the ERP under Academics → Attendance and is usually updated within a day.
NCU generally requires 75% attendance per subject to sit for end-semester exams; check the academic regulations for condonation rules.
If an entry is wrong, contact the course faculty first — only they can correct attendance records.
Medical/duty leave may be condonable as per the attendance policy; apply with documents through the ERP or your school office.

examples: how to register for placement drive
what is the average package for cse
how to prepare for campus placements
when is the next placement drive
responses: The Career Development Centre (CDC) handles placements. Company visits, eligibility and drive dates are mailed to registered students and posted on the ERP.
Placement stats — visiting companies, average and highest packages — are published on the NCU website's placements page each year.
Register with the placement cell to get drive notifications; attendance in CDC training/aptitude sessions is usually mandatory for drives.
Eligibility varies by company. Contact the CDC office for criteria, schedules and interview preparation sessions.

examples: what events are happening this week
which clubs are there in college
how to start a new club
how to register for the hackathon
who to contact for event sponsorship
responses: Upcoming events are announced on the ERP notice board, the NCU Instagram page and student-club groups.
NCU has technical, cultural and sports clubs — auditions and sign-ups usually happen at the start of each semester.
Fests like the annual techno-cultural fest happen once a year; dates are announced by the student council.
To join or start a club, contact the Dean of Student Welfare office — they handle club registrations and event permissions.

examples: is there a bus service from my area
how far is the campus from sohna road
does the bus run on saturday
how to apply for transport facility
is the campus accessible by public transport
responses: NCU runs buses on major routes in Delhi-NCR; route lists, timings and fees are available at the transport office and on the website.
The campus is on NH-48 near Gurugram; the nearest metro connectivity and bus routes are listed on the NCU website's contact page.
Apply for the bus facility at the transport office with your student ID; passes are usually issued per semester.
Student parking is available on campus with a valid pass — get it from the admin office.

examples: what is the eligibility for btech cse
last date to apply for admission
how to get admission in ncu
what percentage is required for admission
is there any scholarship at admission
can I get admission with 80 percent in boards
responses: Admissions are through the NCU website's Apply Now portal; eligibility and accepted exams (like JEE/boards merit) are listed per program.
For eligibility, documents and deadlines, see the Admissions section of the NCU website or call the admission helpline listed there.
B.Tech admission generally considers JEE Main score or qualifying-exam merit; check the criteria for this year's cycle on the website.
The admission cell in the admin block can help with counselling dates, scholarships and document checklists.

responses: I can't determine your identity on my own — I only see the messages you send me here. Tell me your name and I'll happily use it.
I don't have access to your account or profile in this chat. You're talking to the NCU campus assistant — feel free to introduce yourself!
Nothing about who you are is visible to me beyond this chat. But tell me what to call you, and ask me anything campus-related.
I don't know who you are until you tell me — no personal data is attached to this conversation.

examples: is there a canteen on campus
what food is available in the canteen
is the food in the mess good
is there a dominos on campus
how much does a meal cost in canteen
can day scholars eat in the mess
late night food options in hostel
responses: There's a main canteen plus food outlets on campus, open on working days; the hostel mess serves breakfast, lunch, evening snacks and dinner.
The hostel mess menu rotates weekly and includes veg options; timings are posted in the hostel.
Day scholars can buy meals at the canteen/food court on a pay-per-item basis.
For feedback on food quality or hygiene, contact the mess committee or the hostel warden.
